segments.text: What's the pleasure of the Honorable Tiangco?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: What's the parliamentary inquiry of the Honorable Tiangco?

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Madam Speaker, gusto ko lang po malaman kung bakit nilipat po from September 24 ang budget ng House at naging September 17 po.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Your question is bakit nilipat yung—

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Sa original schedule po na nilabas noong September 15, ang original schedule po ng budget ng House is on September 24. Ang nangyari po niyan, inilipat po yan ng September 17.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: So ang tanong ko po, ano po ang dahilan kung bakit po ito nilipat ng September 17?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: May we know from the Majority Leader if this is the only agency that the schedule has been changed or it encompasses other agencies as well?

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Madam Speaker, it wasn't the only agency that was moved.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: I think there were several other agencies that were moved due to requests from the other departments.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: It was actually the deferment of two agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: No, Madam Speaker, can you please name the agency that was moved?

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Because based on my record, ito lang po ang inusod. Ito lang po ang in-advance na ahensya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: So kung meron po, pwede pong sabihin kung ano pong ahensya yung inusod ng mas maaga yung schedule, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: With the indulgence of the Honorable Toby Chango, can we proceed to the additional reference of business?

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: No, Madam Speaker, I do not agree.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: While we are getting the data.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: No, no, no, I do not agree. Let's suspend.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Madam Speaker, upon review of the schedule, the DOT, the PSA, and the Congress of the Philippines budget were all moved to a different schedule.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Madam Speaker, the DOT was moved to a later schedule.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Ang tanong ko, bakit, kasi tignan niyo po, Madam Speaker, September 17 po nun, okay?

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: September 17, meron po naman nakaschedule ng September 18.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Bakit naman doon tayo sa dulo kukuha, Madam Speaker?

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Traditionally, matagal na kayo dito, pag nag-uusod, ang kinukuha yung pinakmalapit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Para makapaghanda po yung hindi lang yung departamento, kung hindi pa rin yung mga congressmen.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Kasi bakit naman po maghahanda yung congressman na mag-deliberate sa isang budget na tatalakayin pa sa September 24?

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Siyempre, tatalakang pag-aaralan niyo po yung September 17, September 18. Una po yan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: With the indulgence of the Honorable Tavi Chanko, if you may,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: this schedule, as arranged by the Committee on Appropriations, is not deliberated in the plenary.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: This is being discussed within the Committee on Appropriations.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: So, with the indulgence of the Honorable Tavi Chanko, if he deems it proper, he can move for the session suspended.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move to call the roll of members.

segments.text: Secretary-General is hereby directed to call the roll of members.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I still have the floor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I had a pending parliamentary inquiry, so I would like to request the Majority Leader to reply to the parliamentary inquiry.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: May we know the parliamentary inquiry of the Honorable Chanko?

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Ang tinanong ko po kanina is kung bakit po nilipat yung budget ng House of Representatives magpula po September 24 papunta pong September 17.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: As what the Majority Leader earlier responded, the adjustment involved the proposed budget.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: The budget of the Department of Tourism and the Congress of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Yes, Madam Speaker, alam ko po na hindi natuloy yung sa Department of Tourism.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Kaya lang po, ang ginagawa po natin, kaya po tayo nagbibigay ng schedules ng budget is para po makapaghanda yung mga members na magtanong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: So kung ang budget ng House ay September 24 pa, natural po ang paghahandaan muna ay yung mga September 18, September 21.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: So mas logical kung doon po humugot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Kaya lang, what was the compelling reason? Ano po yung napakahalaga?

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Bakit inuna yung budget ng House of Representatives when traditionally nasa dulo po yan?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: As I was also the presiding during that week, distinguished colleague, the reason that the budget was adjusted was that two departments were also deferred.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: That is DICT and DEPDEV, specifically the Philippine Statistics Authority.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Hence, the adjustment of the other budgets to an earlier schedule, citing from the motion of the minority and the majority that there were no more interpellators.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: However, if the Hon. Changko is so much willing, we can inform the Committee on Appropriations that you be informed if in case there are other schedules.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Madam Speaker, may precedent na po tayo dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Yung budget po ng MMDA, na-terminate po yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Tapos, the Hon. Tino requested that

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: And pinayagan po siya to reopen.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: So, I'm asking for the same thing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Sa budget ng house, na sana po payagan na ma-reopen yung budget ng house.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Number one, noong pa lang po DBCC, on the first day, nag-request na po ako na dalhin sa committee yung budget ng house.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: So, sa plenaryo na lang po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Hindi po magandang tignan na ang budget ng house, eh hindi man lang pinaliwanag dito sa plenaryo at pinasa natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Kaya po, humihingi po ako ng reconsideration na since pinagbigyan po yung MMDA na ma-reopen,

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: eh sana ma-reopen din po yung sa house.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: At tayo ay nasa isang unique na katayuan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Tayo po ang ahensya at tayo po ang sangay ng gobyerno na may kapangyarihan sa budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Pero tayo lang rin ang sangay ng gobyerno na may control ng budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Yung ibang ahensya po na pupunta dito, pumupunta sila dito sa Kongreso para humingi ng pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Pero hindi po pareho yung nagbibigay at nagre-release ng pondo.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: With the indulgence of our distinguished colleague,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: we are still in the additional reference of business.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: What you are referring to is under unfinished business.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: We will go to that agenda that is third in our agenda.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: The Secretary General is hereby directed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Okay, so babalikan po natin yan after this.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Madam Speaker, papagpatuloy ko lang po. Inusod po yung schedule ng [unclear] po ay pinayagan po ma-reopen para makapagtanong. Dito po sa House, nagre-request po ako ng reopening. Hindi naman po siguro maganda na wala akong nakapagtanong dito sa budget ng House.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Considering po na sa lahat ng sangay ng gobyerno, tayo po ay allowed ng liquidation by certification. So kung allowed po tayo ng liquidation by certification, mas lalong dapat ipaliwanag sa taong bayan papaano po ginagastos yung pera nila dahil hindi naman po natin ito [unclear]. So I'm asking for a motion for reconsideration to reopen the budget of the House and be presented to the plenary in the same way that it was allowed for the MMDA.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: With the indulgence of our distinguished colleague,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: while the proposed budget of the MMDA was indeed reconsidered

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: upon the motion of the majority giving way and yielding way

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: to the listed members who arrived and who wished their intention to interpolate,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: in the case of the budget of the House of Representatives,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: it does not mean that the leadership doesn't want to discuss the proposed budget.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: very much willing to discuss this.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: and with respectful indulgence to our distinguished colleague,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: when a measure, report, or motion is approved, adopted, or lost,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: a member who voted with the majority may move for its reconsideration on the same

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: As we have conferred with the Secretary General,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: the Honorable Toby Chanko was on official business,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: hence, with due courtesy, Honorable Toby Chanko,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: your motion for reconsideration is out of order.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: No, Madam Speaker, it says on the next session day.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: We are not yet on the next session day because we have not yet adjourned.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: So we are still in the same session day, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: So you cannot use that rule, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: It says on the next session day.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: We are still on the same session day, so it's a continuing session.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: So dapat po kung ganyan ang gusto niyong gamitin na rule, dapat po

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: nag-adjourn po noon para next session day, eh Biyernes at hindi na po ako puwedeng mag-motion for reconsideration ngayon.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: I am not actually referring to the next session day.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: I am referring, the presiding officer, referring to a motion for reconsideration of a member

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: who voted with the majority insofar as the motion

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: to terminate the period of interpolation of the proposed budget of the Congress of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Hindi pa po tumadaan yung isang session day, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Anyway, just rule on it, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Kung talagang hindi kayo papayag, then just rule on it.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: The proposed, the interpolations of the proposed budget of the House of Representatives

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: has been terminated as moved by the minority,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: duly seconded by the majority last Thursday, September...

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: A motion for reconsideration is being put forwarded by the Honorable Chanko.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: While the presiding officer would gladly yield,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: unfortunately, our rule states that only a member who had voted with the majority

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: The motion for reconsideration is out of order.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: But I think more than the rules, transparency is more important than our rules.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: Kung wala pong accountability, kung wala pong transparency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Tobias "Toby" M. Tiangco
segments.text: So, but if that is your rule, then I will respect it.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Thank you very much, Honorable Chanko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move to consider the proposed budget of the Commission on Audit.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: consider the proposed budget of the Commission on Audit.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Hearing none, the period of sponsorship debate and interpolation on the proposed budget of the Commission on Audit is hereby opened.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Madam Speaker, may we acknowledge the heads and officials of the Commission on Audit,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Assistant Commissioner Martha Roxana Cese, Assistant Commissioner Lorna Cabotchan, Assistant Commissioner Roy Ursal, Assistant Commissioner Joel Estolatan, Assistant Commissioner Lito Martin, Assistant Commissioner Bresilo Sabaldan, Assistant Commissioner Lucila Isidro, Assistant Commissioner Sofia Hemora, and Assistant Commissioner Estela Mercado.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Commission on Audit family, headed by the Chairperson, Gamaliel Cordoba, who never ages except for the missing few strands of hair.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Maraming salamat sa pagdalo dito sa Kongreso kasama ang COA family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move that we open the period of sponsorship and debate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marie Bernadette G. Escudero
segments.text: I move that we recognize the Honorable Vice Chairperson, the Honorable John Tracy Cagas, of the Lone District of Davao del Sur, to sponsor the proposed budget of the Commission on Audit.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: The Honorable Vice Chairperson, John Tracy Cagas, of the Lone District of Davao del Sur, is hereby recognized to sponsor the proposed budget of the Commission on Audit.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: I would like also to include or acknowledge the respective

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: Regional Directors of COA, from the different regions of our beloved country.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: Madam Speaker, distinguished colleagues, magandang hapon po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: It is my honor to sponsor the budget of the Commission on Audit for Fiscal Year 2027,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: 16.46 billion pesos, inclusive of the automatic appropriations.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: In terms of new appropriations, which is subject for Congressional approval,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: the total budget of COA amounts to 14.774 billion,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: which represents an increase of about 2.49%.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: or 359.12 million, higher than the Fiscal Year 2026 level of 14.415 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: Madam Speaker, this budget will be used to support the Commission's program, activities, and operations,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: to ensure accountability for public resources,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: in partnership with stakeholders for the benefit of the Filipino people.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: The Commission on Audit is the supreme auditing institution of our nation.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: It is the ultimate guardian for the public treasury

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: and the bedrock of fiscal accountability.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: COA does not merely look at numbers. It ensures that every single peso contributed by our hardworking taxpayers is spent efficiently, effectively, and entirely for its intended public purpose.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: The proposed budget is a vital investment in good governance.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: By equipping COA with necessary resources, we are strengthening its capability to conduct rigorous audits, expand its workforce of dedicated state auditors,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: and adopt digital innovations that bring greater transparency.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: To starve COA of resources is to weaken our defenses against waste and corruption.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: To support COA is to fortify the integrity of our entire bureaucracy.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: As we steer our nation toward broader economic growth and development,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: oversight institutions remain strong, independent, and fully capable.

segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, pinag-aaralan po ng ating komisyon yung suggestion po ng ating kasamahan na kapag nagka-register ka, naka-enroll na rin po. So marami pong activities ang ginagawa po ng Comelec para po

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: mas mapaigting at mapadami po yung overseas registration para po sa ating Comelec. Nagsasagawa po sila ng iba?t ibang town hall meetings, lalo na po sa ating mga Filipino community leaders.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Pero dadagdagan pa po nila ng voters education on the full process po, lalo na po ng ating online voting na isinasagawa

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: para po sa convenience po ng ating mga kababayan abroad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: May mga mock voting na rin po silang planong gawin and system demos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Pati mas madaling enrollment po sa kanila at help desk and feedback channels na pwedeng matawagan o mapagsabihan po ng ating mga kababayan abroad

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: through Komelec DFA and community partners.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: So nakalatag na rin po ang

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: mga plano ng komisyon para po mas mapaigting po yung ating registration sa overseas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat Mr. Speaker at magandang balita po na halimbawa meron po pakikipagtulungan sa OWA, sa Marina, sa DMW

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para po bago umalis ang ating mga kababayang OFWs ay meron na silang gagawing registration

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na kumaari nga ay maisama na rin yung enrollment para isahan na lang po na matatapos ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang mga kababayan ang ginagawang pag-aaral ng Komelec kung paano matitiyak na hindi lang mapapabilis

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ngunit matitiyak na yung mga kababayan natin na registered na ay enrolled na rin dun sa bagong sistema na gagamitin para sa susunod na eleksyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil Mr. Speaker, na ibalita rin sa atin ang Komelec noong budget briefing na para sa 2028 national elections,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: internet voting na ang gagamitin sa 104 na post.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang ibig sabihin po ba nito ay fully online voting na po ang ating gagamitin at hindi na po by post or in-person voting ang mangyayari para sa susunod na eleksyon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, fully online na po ang gagamitin po ng ating komisyon for the 2028 elections.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, hindi po ba tayo nababahala doon sa mga concerns na dahil bago pa lang po ang ating sistema, marahil kinakailangan pa ng mas maraming oras para sa mas malawak na information and education effort para malaman ng ating mga kababayan na

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: 100% ang gagamitin na po natin ay online voting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Marami pa pong mga concerns tungkol dun sa nabanggit ko na tila ba second process ng registration yung enrollment process na kailangan pang pagdaanan ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya po sa ngayon, yung pondo po na naibigay sa atin na nakalakip sa General Appropriations Bill para sa 2027,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At ng mga nais nating maabot sa ibang bansa, may it be through satellite registration overseas or through our collaboration with other agencies to reach more Filipinos overseas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, kulang po yung naibigay na budget para po sa ating Comelec regarding voters education with regard sa online voting po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Ang gusto po sana ng Komelec ay full process ang ma-inform po sa ating mga kababayan abroad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Maalaman po nila kung paano po gamitin talaga ang online voting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: At sa ngayon po, yung online voting and counting system naman po ay nagsasagwa pa rin po ng TOR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Mas gusto pa rin po ng komisyon na maging user-friendly po para po sa ating mga kababayan abroad para po sa convenience nila sa pagboto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Ang ginagawa sa ating online voting para po ba sigurado yung boto at yung pangamba po ng ating mga kababayan abroad ay mawala po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, tayo po ay nanghingi na rin ng assessment ng Komelec tungkol sa paggamit ng bagong online voting system na ito na ginamit sa una pagkakataon dito ng 2025

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at gagamitin muli sa mas maraming jurisdiction sa susunod na national elections.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yan po ang aabangan natin mula sa ating distinguished sponsor at sa ating komisyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pangalawa, meron din mga panukalang batas na sa ngayon ay subject na ng deliberation dito sa House of Representatives

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: tungkol naman sa pagkakaroon ng iba't iba pa rin na modalities pagdating sa pagboto at pagtitiyak ng pagbilang ng boto ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Na habang may option para sa online voting ay meron pa rin opsyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: By post or in person kung ano ang pinakaabot kamay sa ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Lahat po yan para sa interes ng pagtitiyak ng kanilang karapatan sa pagboto, ng karapatan sa pagpili ng kanilang mga susunod na leader,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ng ating mga susunod na mamumuno sa ating bayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman po, nais kong magtanong, ginoong Speaker, tungkol sa katatapos na makasaysayang BARMM elections.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang mga katanungan po ng kinatawan na ito ay tungkol sa katatapos lamang na barm parliamentary elections noong September 14, 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At ito po ay batay sa mga tanong, sa mga obserbasyon ng mga grupo ng iba't ibang civil society organizations na accredited ng COMELEC bilang local observers sa nasabing parliamentary election.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Una po, ano po ang naging aksyon ng COMELEC na kaugnay ng mga ulat mula po sa ilang mga lugar na merong mga botante na nagsabi, nagulat,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na hindi sila nakaboto dahil ang kanilang mga balota ay di umano'y pre-shaded na o mayroon ng mga nakamarkang mga pangalan ng kandidato bago pa po nila ito matanggap.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Gaano ba kalawak ang mga ulat na ito? Nadinig na po ba ito ng COMELEC? At may sinasagawa na po ba sa ngayon na investigation para matiyak ang katotohanan sa mga ulat na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, yung regarding po, specifically yung sa Maluso, Basilan, nagkaroon po ng pre-shading po ng ballots.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Ang naka-discovery po ng pre-shading rin po na yan ay COMELEC. So ang naging action po ng ating buting komisyon ay ma-recall po yung mga pre-shaded na ballots.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: At kinaalam na po, well may sampina na rin po lahat po ng posibleng nagtamper po dito po sa mga balotang ito based on sa chain of custody.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Ng mga balotang ito, actually kahapon po inilabas yung sampina po para po dito sa mga posibleng malagot po sa pre-shading po ng ballots. Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, maari po bang magbigay ng espesipikong bilang ang ating distinguished sponsor kung gano po karami itong mga natanggap na mga reports na sa ngayon ay dumadaan na sa proseso ng verifikasyon at investigasyon ng ating...

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, based on sa mga reports po na sinasabi po ng ating buting kasamahan, more or less 10 reports po yung bine-verify nila regarding this matter sa mga insidente po sa Bangsamoro Elections.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, kung meron na pong initial na report, ukol dito ang...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Paari pong maisumite na lang sa ating Committee on Appropriations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At nais ko pong magtanong, paano po ba natin matitiyak o ano yung ating mga hakbang para matiyak?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Halimbawa yung transparency sa proseso ng pag-uulat ng ganitong tipo ng mga kaso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Meron po ba silang timely na updating doon sa mga side ng mga...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mahapag o naghahain ng kanilang mga complaint upang matiyak na agarang naaaksyonan ang ganitong tipo ng mga ulat?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, na Commission ensures na open po sila sa mga ganitong updates po regarding po sa iba't ibang kaso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: So, ang gusto po nila, pag may mga insidente na kailangan po ma-report po sa ating Commission,

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: at least, paisabi po, ma-inform po sila para po immediately magawan po nila ng aksyon kung ano po yung nararapat, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon, Mr. Speaker, tungkol naman po sa ulat rin ng malaking deployment ng military and uniformed personnel sa ilang mga lugar sa BARM noong panahon ng halalan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ano po ba ang naging batayan at layunan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At paano po tinitiyak ng COMELEC na ang presensya halimbawa ng military uniformed personnel o ng mga security forces ay hindi po nakakalikha ng anumang tipo ng pagbabanta o nantakot sa mga botante at hindi nakakaapekto sa malayang pagboto ng ating mga kababayan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: more on yung focus po ng ating pong COMELEC,

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: during the BARM is yung mga red category areas, yung mga areas na may historical basis ng violence rin po during elections.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Ang kasigurahan lang po siguro ang mapapakita po na mapayapang nakaboto yung ating pong mga kababayan po mula sa BARM is dahil 84% po ang turnout ng voting sa ating pong Bangsamoro.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Dahil po doon sa ganong data,

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: ito po ang napapakita ng data na ito is malaking tulong po yung ating pong kapulisan sa malayang pagboto po ng ating pong mga kababayan sa BARM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, higit po nating pag-aaralan ang isusumiteng initial report ng Comelec tungkol dito upang matiyak po natin ang interes ng malayang pagboto at ang pagkakaroon ng halalan na

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: pantay, na patas at malinis po sa lahat ng mga naghahangad na ito ay buong-buong magtagumpay. Ngayon naman po, tungkol naman sa hindi lang po hiling pero panawagan ng representasyong ito, at nawa?y makasama natin dito ang distinguished sponsor. Napakalaki ho ng budget cut para sa programa na may kinalaman sa online voting para po sa ating mga

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: overseas na voters. Gayundin po, napakababa ng pondo para sa voter information and education program. Ito po yung mga programa na magtitiyak ng tagumpay ng halalan ay hindi po nakadepende lang sa Comelec. Pero magtitiyak na yung tao mismo, ang ating mga kababayan mismo, ay nakakaalam kung paano sila magbabantay at kung paano sila kasama sa pagtitiyak ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: karapatan sa pagboto at kung paano rin sila kasama sa pagtataguyod ng tunay na demokrasya dito sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At sana po makasama natin ang distinguished sponsor sa panawagan na ma-restore sa 2026 level ang mga programang ito kung hindi man madagdagan para makahabol po tayo sa target na mas maraming registered voters para sa susunod na halalan. Maraming salamat, Mr. Speaker. Maraming salamat, distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Maraming salamat sa comment. Thank you, Mr. Speaker, at thank you to our colleague na sumusuporta po sa madagdagan pa yung mga budget na nawala po sa ating komisyon. And we will submit po lahat po ng hinihinging impormasyon ng ating kasamahan. Thank you, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
Rep. Ernesto "Ernix" Dionisio Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move to recognize Representative Sergio Dagooc of APEC Party-list.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
segments.text: Representative Dagooc is recognized. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker. Thank you, Majority Leader. Mr. Speaker, there being no other members from the minority who wanted to interpellate, I move to terminate the period of interpellation and debate on the proposed budget of the Commission on Elections for fiscal year 2027. Mr. Speaker, thank you very much.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
Rep. Ernesto "Ernix" Dionisio Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, on the part of the majority, we join the minority in the motion to terminate the interpellations on the proposed budget of the Commission on Elections.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
segments.text: There is a joint motion to terminate the interpellations on the proposed budget of the Commission on Elections. Is there any objection? The Chair hears none. The interpellations on the proposed budget of the Commission on Elections are hereby terminated.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
Rep. Ernesto "Ernix" Dionisio Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move to suspend session for a few minutes.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
Rep. Ernesto "Ernix" Dionisio Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move that we now consider

segments.speaker: Rep. Ernesto "Ernix" Dionisio Jr.
segments.text: the proposed budget of the Anti-Red Tape Authority.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
segments.text: The Chair hears none. Motion is approved.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
Rep. Ernesto "Ernix" Dionisio Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, may we acknowledge the presence of the heads and officials of the Anti-Red Tape Authority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ernesto "Ernix" Dionisio Jr.
segments.text: They are Director General Ernesto Perez, Deputy Director General Lea Salcedo, Deputy Director General Rocco Jod, Echeverry, Deputy Director General Pua Billy Racho.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
segments.text: We acknowledge the presence of the heads and officials from the Anti-Red Tape Authority, headed by Director General Perez.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
segments.text: Welcome to the House of Representatives. Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ernesto "Ernix" Dionisio Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I now move to recognize Representative Isabel L. Sagarbarria of the Second District of Negros Occidental,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ernesto "Ernix" Dionisio Jr.
segments.text: Vice Chairperson of the Committee on Appropriations, to answer questions on the proposed budget of the Anti-Red Tape Authority.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
segments.text: Representative Sagarbarria is recognized. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleagues, it is my honor and privilege to sponsor the proposed budget of the Anti-

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: Sorry, of the Anti-Money Laundering Council, of the Anti-Red Tape Authority, under the House Bill number 10858,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: or the Fiscal Year 2027 General Appropriations Bill, amounting to P436,720,000, since its establishment pursuant to Republic Act number 11032,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: or the Ease of Doing Business

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: and Efficient Government Service Delivery Act of 2018,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: ARTA has placed a significant role in reducing regulatory burdens,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: and encouraging government agencies to adopt more efficient and digitalized systems.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: In just 80 years, ARTA has become a vital institution in our bureaucracy,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: reduce red tape, and strengthen public trust in government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: The proposed budget of ARTA aims to ensure that the authority continues to function effectively,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: uphold reforms, and deliver on its mandate to make government services more efficient,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: Its proposed initiatives, including the enhancement of the digital platforms,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: and other digital-based programs are directed toward making government transactions

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: more accessible, transparent, and efficient for the Filipino people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: When we strengthen the ARTA anti-red tape authority,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: To empower ARTA is to empower the entire bureaucracy to serve with speed, fairness, and integrity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: a government that defeats red tape is a government that delivers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: The government that delivers is a government that earns trust.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: The government that earns trust is a government that truly serves its people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: I respectfully seek the support of this honorable house

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: for the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget of the anti-red tape authority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker. This representation is now ready to answer questions from our colleagues.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
segments.text: Thank you very much. Majority Leader?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ernesto "Ernix" Dionisio Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I now move to recognize Representative Iris Marie de Mesa Montes of Party List 4K to interpolate the sponsor on the proposed budget of the anti-red tape.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Vincent Franco "Duke" D. Frasco
segments.text: Representative Iris Marie de Mesa Montes is recognized. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Magandang hapon po, Distinguished Sponsor and to the ARTA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ilang katanungan lamang po mula sa Kababaihan Kabalikatan para sa Kapakanan at Kaunlaran ng Bayan or 4K.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Una po, your budget, proposed budget for 2027 of 537 million is slightly higher than the current budget, mga around 14 million. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Based on the current year's budget, budget for 2027 is sufficient to perform your mandate of reducing red tape in government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: No. No, it is not, no.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ano po, what programs will be affected given this decrease in budget specifically?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: What programs will be affected will not be funded, what processes will be compromised, what activities?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: This reduction runs contrary to ARTA's direction of expanding its reach and strengthening the implementation, Republic of 11032.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: The proposed cut will constrain ARTA's capacity to assist the government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: The proposed cut will constrain ARTA's capacity to assist and capacitate government agencies in complying with the law directly affecting its mandate to reduce, if not eliminate, red tape in government services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: It will also delay ongoing systems development intended to speed up complaints handling, improve data gathering, and strengthen database security and management.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: Our regional field offices, we likewise have to scale back orientation and inspection activities because of reduced funding for travel,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: fuel, supplies, training, and other operational requirements.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, these resources needed to translate the law into actual improvements in government services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: Reducing them will limit ARTA's ability to deliver the reforms expected of it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Regarding po sa citizen complaints, how many complaints about red tape did ARTA receive last year for 2025?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ilan po ang na-resolve within the mandated timeline?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: Actually, as of 2026, the total cases received was 12,335.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: And the resolved cases within the turnaround time is 11,208, which is 90.86%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ano man po, ano yung mga five agencies that received the most complaints?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Can you name the top five agencies?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: The ten most complained government-owned and controlled corporations from January 2, August 31, 2026

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: are the Home Development Mutual Fund, Pag-IBIG, which is the highest,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria
segments.text: Social Security System, GSIS, PhilHealth, Land Bank of the Philippines, PhilPost,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Isabel L. Sagarbarria

segments.text: Dahil we are aware of the four pillars ng Philippine National Action Plan on Women, Peace and Security,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: sa tingin po natin ang mga nabanggit ay hindi pa po nakakasama doon sa nalalatag sa iba't-ibang mga gawain ng OPAPRU.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Kaya naman po, continuously, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: we'd like to manifest that we reject the use of women's bodies and communities as collateral in military alliances and war economies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, hintayin na lang po natin ang mga ulat na nirequest ng kinatawan na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: But for now, maraming salamat sa mga pagsagot sa tanong natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: I yield to the floor my remaining time, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Thank you very much, Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Joboy" S. Aquino II
segments.text: Before that, Mr. Speaker, the OPAPRU wish to extend an invitation to the honorable members of this House,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Joboy" S. Aquino II
segments.text: to OPAP office for more briefing with regards to women, peace, security.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Thank you very much, Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Katrina Reiko Chua-Tai
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, next to interpellate the sponsor, I move that we recognize the honorable Presley C. De Jesus of Philreca Partylist.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: The gentleman from Philreca Partylist, honorable Presley De Jesus.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, there being no more members of the minority who wish to interpellate,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I move to terminate the sponsorship and debate on the budget of OPAPRU.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Before I call the majority, thank you.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Before I call the majority, please be reminded, the Vice Chair Joboy,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: and the Department of the requested documents and promised documents to those who ask.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Majority Leader, what does the House say?

segments.speaker: Rep. Katrina Reiko Chua-Tai
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, on the part of the majority, we join the minority in the motion to terminate the period of interpellation

segments.speaker: Rep. Katrina Reiko Chua-Tai
segments.text: on the proposed budget of the Office of the Presidential Advisor on Peace, Reconciliation, and Unity.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: There is a joint motion to terminate the interpellation of the proposed budget of the OPAPRU.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: The interpellation of the proposed budget of the Office of the Presidential Advisor on Peace, Reconciliation, and Unity is hereby terminated.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Rep. Katrina Reiko Chua-Tai
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move that we suspend for a few minutes.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
